proposed_from.topic: Sharp policy-value bounds and whole-set inference for finite-horizon off-policy evaluation with MNAR discrete rewards and an incomplete next-state weak shadow. The known behavior policy uses recorded history, while a fixed complete-information deployment policy may depend on latent reward history. Define full-history compatible laws by observed-cell marginalization, known behavior factors, positivity, and weak-shadow cross-product equations. Prove attained sharp endpoints for the policy-value polynomial, an observable necessary-and-sufficient factorization-versus-strict-containment theorem relative to stagewise Chen programs, and whole-set coverage by simultaneous multinomial confidence-fiber inversion with certified global optimization. Reanalyse the Wang et al. and Wei et al. sepsis OPE workflows. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: In the finite full-history simplex, observed-data and behavior restrictions are linear, weak-shadow restrictions are polynomial cross-products, and the fixed-policy value is linear in the compatible full-law probabilities; compactness therefore gives attained extrema, while confidence-fiber inversion covers the whole true set whenever the observed law lies in the multinomial fiber. Exact arithmetic for the two-stage three-reward witness verifies Aw=beta, the null direction, normalization, completion-dependent policy occupancy, and the value interval [229/140,26/15]. Static T=1, reward-history-blind targets, completeness, zero-cell boundaries, and the supplied-source collision set were checked without defeating the coupled program; generic semialgebraic optimization alone would not carry the tier. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the observable rectangularity/extremizing-face theorem characterizing exactly when the global full-history fiber contains simultaneous stagewise extrema and when reward-history policy dependence forces strict containment. EARLY KILL TEST: On the smallest two-stage binary-action models with one and then two MNAR three-level rewards, compute certified global extrema and the correctly continuation-weighted rectangular Chen relaxation; if every nondegenerate instance agrees, pivot because the dynamic non-factorization headline collapses.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The sole novelty target is the exact two-stage generic strict-containment obligation. It requires a fully enumerated rational observed table and completion map, coefficient-expanded observable minors with printed signs, a certified nonempty relatively open region, a cell-by-cell rational witness with a strict endpoint gap, and an exact exceptional equality variety. The compact common-face lemma is supporting geometry and contributes no field-level novelty. Chen, Simchi-Levi, and Xiong already supply the one-stage program in the source section titled ``Partial Identification via Linear Programs,'' at equation label \(\texttt{opt:mnar-with-shadow-matrix-form-theta}\), with the full-column-rank conclusion at proposition label \(\texttt{prop:point-id-mean}\); that reduction contributes no novelty or theorem count. Iyengar (2005), Section 2, Theorem 2.1 (finite-horizon robust Bellman equation), p. 261, assumes rectangular ambiguity to obtain robust recursion, while the open obligation must prove strict nonrectangularity of an inverse observed-data fiber. The maintained condition \(S_{t+1}\perp M_t\mid(H_t^F,A_t,R_t)\) is a novel full-history recording/transition exclusion and is logically incomparable with Wei, Qu, and Miao's current-state exclusion without additional sufficiency assumptions.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, Section 3, Theorem 1, and Appendix proof of Theorem 1; the proof pastes conditional LP minimizers across observed covariate strata.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The source archive for arXiv:2602.16061 was opened. The introduction and conclusion were read, together with the sharpness construction based on \(A_x w_x=\beta_x\) and the proof that conditional minimizers can be pasted across \(x\).
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed proof step is the pasting step: a latent reward completion changes later deployment weights, so independently extremal one-period completions need not be marginals of one trajectory law.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for dynamic weak-shadow partial identification, latent-reward-history policy evaluation, and rectangular Chen bounds found point-identifying sequential bridge papers and robust-control rectangularity, but no data-induced face-pasting theorem.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that equality is immediate from Iyengar's rectangularity theorem because both problems merely paste conditional distributions.
seed_details.rebuttal: Iyengar takes rectangular ambiguity as primitive; here the ambiguity set is the inverse image of observed MNAR cells and polynomial weak-shadow restrictions, and the missing result is an observable criterion for whether its extremizing faces paste.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is not a single witness or a generic polynomial-program claim: it requires an if-and-only-if face criterion, strictness on a nondegenerate region, an exact small witness, and whole-set inference.
seed_details.burned_reason: Selected seeds were incorporated, but four D0 solve rounds could not lift the dynamic-face-pasting kernel to a full-space theorem; the other two contributed only incremental support.

seed_details.anchor_location: Sections 3--4 and the main algorithmic result on polynomialization, spatial branch-and-bound, and \(\varepsilon\)-sharp outer certificates.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The arXiv abstract and the published JASA text were opened; the central construction maps discrete compatible laws and causal queries to polynomial programs and maintains certified outer bounds during branch-and-bound.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to invert one simultaneous exact multinomial law before optimizing, rather than attach pointwise endpoint uncertainty after a nonsmooth optimizer has selected a face.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches located calibrated projection and criterion inversion, but no exact multinomial confidence-fiber inversion for a dynamically coupled weak-shadow equality variety with zero cells.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that set coverage follows tautologically from any confidence set for the observed multinomial law.
seed_details.rebuttal: The inclusion argument is simple, but the publishable content is exact whole-set inversion across singular and zero-cell strata together with certified global inner and outer endpoint computation and a semialgebraic Hausdorff modulus.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This is an inference rung attached to a non-LP semialgebraic identified-set shape, not a bare \(M8\) seed.
seed_details.burned_reason: Selected seeds were incorporated, but four D0 solve rounds could not lift the dynamic-face-pasting kernel to a full-space theorem; the other two contributed only incremental support.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction and the representer characterization of strongly identified linear functionals in the presence of nonunique conditional-moment solutions.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The source archive for arXiv:2208.08291 was opened. The introduction, main representer result, and conclusion were read; the proof boundary is the passage from nuisance nonuniqueness to invariance of a linear functional.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step replaces one linear conditional-moment solution set by a polynomial trajectory fiber in which reward completion also changes continuation occupancy.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found Li, Miao, and Tchetgen Tchetgen's static necessary-and-sufficient mean-functional result and Wei, Qu, and Miao's complete sequential bridge, but not an observable constancy criterion for latent-history-dependent policy value.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that policy value is identified whenever each reward mean lies in the row space of its shadow operator.
seed_details.rebuttal: That row-space argument ignores that the deployment policy and later state occupancy vary with the unidentified latent reward history; constancy must hold on the coupled trajectory variety, not stage by stage.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The target is an exact if-and-only-if constancy certificate, rather than completeness restated as a sufficient condition.
seed_details.burned_reason: Selected seeds were incorporated, but four D0 solve rounds could not lift the dynamic-face-pasting kernel to a full-space theorem; the other two contributed only incremental support.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, Theorems 1--3, and the discussion of the practical difficulty of selecting a valid shadow variable.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The source archive for arXiv:2507.06961 was opened. The introduction, MNAR identification construction, asymptotic value results, and concluding limitations were read.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step replaces every exact weak-shadow cross-product equality by an odds-ratio slab and then propagates the jointly feasible violation through latent reward histories.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found proximal sensitivity formulas under linear structural models and sequential hidden-confounding sensitivity sets, but not critical-radius weak-shadow validity for MNAR rewards.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that the sensitivity interval is obtained by adding slack to the existing constraints.
seed_details.rebuttal: The missing object is the sharp, continuation-aware critical radius at which a policy ranking reverses; separate stagewise slack programs do not preserve a common trajectory law.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed specifies a critical radius and sharp global region, avoiding sufficient-only sensitivity.

seed_details.anchor_location: Sections 2--3, especially Assumption 1 and the robust Bellman recursion under a product of conditional-measure sets.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The publisher page and publicly indexed theorem text were opened. The introduction, rectangular product construction, dynamic-programming theorem, and conclusion were read.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step is to derive, from observed-cell equalities, a dual support-function defect measuring failure of conditional-measure pasting rather than assume a product ambiguity set.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for nonrectangular robust MDP support functions and data-induced ambiguity fibers did not locate a closed observable defect for MNAR shadow restrictions.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that the defect is just the numerical difference between two optimization values.
seed_details.rebuttal: The proposed object is a dual certificate in observable cell probabilities whose zero set is exactly the face-pasting frontier and whose sign gives quantitative strictness.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The representation must be an explicit support-function or dual certificate, not an unspecified infimum.

seed_details.anchor_location: Section 3 sharp weak-shadow bounds and the conclusion's decision-making motivation.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The paper's LP sharpness proof and conclusion were read; they bound a fixed mean and do not choose a sequential policy over a coupled fiber.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step replaces evaluation of a fixed policy by maximin selection over a policy class while retaining one shared compatible full-history law in each value comparison.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found empirical welfare maximization and confounding-robust policy learning, but not regret frontiers for dynamically coupled MNAR weak-shadow identified sets.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that maximizing the lower endpoint is standard robust policy optimization.
seed_details.rebuttal: A publishable version needs an oracle regret bound and lower bound indexed by fiber width and policy complexity; these are not delivered by computing lower endpoints.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The theorem loss is policy regret to a feasible oracle, not estimation error for a fixed value.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction and Proposition 2 on how weak-shadow restrictions tighten the no-shadow identification interval.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The source proof comparing the shadow and no-shadow programs was read, including the strict-tightening condition based on feasible missing-outcome allocations.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step optimizes which next-state coarsening or auxiliary measurement to record before data collection, using worst-case dynamic value width rather than static mean width.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches located active label collection with predictors but no acquisition certificate for a future-state weak shadow in sequential MNAR OPE.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that more informative shadows mechanically tighten bounds by set inclusion.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nontrivial result would characterize an optimal coarsening under a measurement budget and certify its approximation ratio for worst-case policy-value width.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The measurement rule and its certificate are named decision objects; monotonicity alone is not counted as the result.

seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction, Theorem 1, Appendix identification proof, and the MIMIC-III sepsis evaluation.
seed_details.anchor_opened: The source archive for arXiv:2606.20206 was opened. The motivation, bridge moment, completeness-based identification theorem, proof, sepsis setup, and conclusion were read.
seed_details.proof_boundary: The first changed step shares response or transition restrictions across source hospitals while allowing site-specific incomplete shadows and deployment occupancies.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches found transportability and data-fusion bounds, but no finite-horizon MNAR weak-shadow OPE result coupling sites through latent reward histories.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical objection is that sites can simply be added as an observed covariate in the static weak-shadow program.
seed_details.rebuttal: That reduction does not exploit cross-site restrictions and does not solve continuation coupling when deployment and transition laws differ by site.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed requires an explicit cross-site coupling restriction and a sharp data-fusion gain, rather than relabeling site as a covariate.
